morphology.pattern_note: 借词作为独立词素记忆，不拆成 tau + fan；au 在首音节中构成双元音。未列未经核实的加缀派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 猛烈的风暴；在气象报道中常指台风。
senses.en_definition: A violent windstorm; especially a typhoon in meteorological reporting.
senses.nuances: 马来语释义引自《Kamus Dewan》第四版。普通词典义较宽；气象语境下须依具体系统区分 taufan、ribut petir 与 puting beliung，不能把每场雷雨或龙卷风都译成 typhoon。[DBP PRPM：taufan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=taufan)；[METMalaysia：Fenomena Cuaca](https://www.met.gov.my/pendidikan/fenomena-cuaca/)

collocations.zh: 遭受台风或猛烈风暴袭击
collocations.en: to be hit by a typhoon or violent storm

dual_scenarios.ms: Beberapa kawasan pesisir di negara itu mengalami kerosakan teruk selepas dilanda taufan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该国数个沿海地区遭台风袭击后严重受损。
dual_scenarios.en: Several coastal areas in the country suffered severe damage after being hit by a typhoon.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友关心海外亲属
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kakak kau kat Filipina tu okey tak? Aku dengar ada taufan.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kakak kamu yang berada di Filipina selamat? Saya mendengar bahawa terdapat taufan di sana.
dual_scenarios.zh: 你在菲律宾的姐姐还好吗？我听说那边有台风。
dual_scenarios.en: Is your sister in the Philippines okay? I heard there's a typhoon there.

okey tak 构成口语的是非疑问

etymology.historical_story: Taufan belongs to the Arabic loan vocabulary of Malay and corresponds to Arabic ṭūfān, associated with overwhelming floods and storms. Its Jawi spelling preserves the Arabic letter ṭāʾ. Remembering the word as a whole connects its borrowed written form with the powerful weather it names, without inventing Malay components inside it. [Al-Zubaidi: Arabic Borrowed Words in Bahasa Melayu](https://awej-tls.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/18.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 tau-fan，联想“滔天风浪翻涌”：taufan＝猛烈风暴／台风。这是声音联想，不是汉语词源。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于新闻、工作汇报和日常交流均自然。询问受灾亲友时，可先问 Adakah semuanya selamat?，表达对人员安全的关心。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 谈实际灾情时使用准确地点和可靠消息，避免夸张转述。把凌乱房间比作遭风暴袭击属于玩笑语境，在受灾者面前应慎用。
